'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, kid, I have bad news. Word reached me that a bunch of scum had settled somewhere on the coast beyond the collapsed tunnel. They do whatever the hell they want, harass the whole territory - like a pack of wild wolves. And it's not even some local bandits, but your former work colleagues. As I understand it, when the whole conflict began, their main base was somewhere on the cape. Unlike you, these do not want to return home, but to plunder our land to the last, those bastards! Get rid of them and be careful, soldier.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 10 [[Rogues]] on [[Lighthouse]]

==Rewards==
* +9,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 110,000 Roubles
** 115,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 126,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
* Unlocks craft for [[12/70 AP-20 armor-piercing slug]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 3]]
{{quote|Finally, you're back! I've started to worry. Come, let me at least get you something to eat.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 10 [[Rogues]] on any location.
